name: panel-source-dialog
pre: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const kebab = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b => (b.getAttribute('aria-label')||'').includes('more') || b.textContent.trim() === 'more_vert'); kebab[0]?.click(); await sleep(800); const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mat-mdc-menu-item, [role="menuitem"]')]; items.find(i => i.textContent.includes('编辑'))?.click(); await sleep(1200); return 'ok'; })()

name: panel-player-startup
pre: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const hs = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,.section-title,.card-title')]; const t = hs.find(h => h.textContent.includes('播不了')); if (t) { t.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); } else { window.scrollTo(0, 900); } await sleep(900); return t ? 'found' : 'scrolled'; })()
